Following a suspension in June, JP Morgan has resumed coverage of Hims & Hers Health
at neutral, saying that the telehealth company is facing headwinds in its GLP-1 compounding business. It was last rated as overweight.
The bank has a $32 price target (~17% upside based on Sept. 10 close).

Analyst Brian Smilek said that while he views Hims and Hers' vertical integration and expansion across specialties and geographies as a positive, "we look for execution across the strategic transition toward branded GLP-1s, durability of growth across newer specialties, deeper international penetration, and durable margin expansion."
While its GLP-1 compounding business is more limited given

from the US FDA, he believes that its partnership with Novo Nordisk (NOVO) to sell its GLP-1 drugs Wegovy and Ozempic "should more than offset compounded GLP-1 headwinds," adding that "near-term adjusted EBITDA margins face headwinds from the mix shift toward branded GLP-1s."
Smilek noted that peptides are a growth opportunity beyond the company's current offerings.

title: Hims & Hers Health resumed at JP Morgan at neutral on GLP-1 compounding headwinds
